title: A handful of failed skill checks (e.g. 'go through before nerve fails' at the Hundred Gallery fall, 'shore the dike' at Fenmarch) raise the DC on retry, which is well-telegraphed, but the initial DC/modifier math shown before rolling doesn't always make the true odds obvious (e.g. DC 10 with +3 shown as 'roll 7+' is fine, but DC vs total-needed phrasing took a few tries to parse confidently).
